summary:
Solution-focused Full-Stack Web Developer with 5.5+ years of experience, including 2.8 years in a full-stack
role since March 2023. Previously worked in UI/UX design and front-end development (3.5 years). Skilled in
developing scalable and high-performance web applications using Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, and
MongoDB. Experienced in implementing caching with Redis and asynchronous messaging with RabbitMQ for
optimized backend performance and system reliability. Proficient in REST API development, Agile
methodology, and tools like GitLab, Postman, and BrowserStack. Committed to writing clean, maintainable
code and delivering seamless user experiences.
